summary: Iter60 — Live Feed (Catholic miracles) feature end-to-end PASS. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (test_miracles_iter60.py). GET /api/miracles returns 6 published seed claims (Lanciano, Guadalupe, Buenos Aires, Carlo Acutis, Fátima, Medjugorje) each with claim_id/title/summary/type/verdict ∈ {reported, investigating, approved, not_supernatural}/location/reported_year/source_name/source_url; drafts never leak into the public list. Localization: Accept-Language: es/it translate title+summary+location (Italian: 'Il Miracolo Eucaristico di Lanciano' / 'Approvato dalla Chiesa'; Spanish: 'El Milagro Eucarístico de Lanciano' / 'Aprobado por la Iglesia'). Admin lifecycle works: GET /admin/all lists drafts+published, PATCH verdict (with 400 on invalid value), POST publish/unpublish, GET single 404, and unpublished claims disappear from the public list immediately. Permissions: /api/miracles/admin/* returns 403 for a freshly-provisioned non-admin user; /api/miracles still returns 200 for them. AI generate endpoint skipped from CI (slow ~30-90s) — but backend logs from iter context + our session show POST /api/miracles/admin/generate returning 200; admin screen shows 6 DRAFT cards from the prior generate run (e.g., 'Vilakkannur Eucharistic Miracle: Face of Christ Appears on Host', '72nd Miracle of Lourdes', etc.) with real source links. Frontend (mobile 390x844, web): /community/miracles header 'Live Feed' + 6 cards, type icon + title + 'Location · Year' + colored verdict badge (Approved by the Church green ×4, Under Investigation amber ×2) + summary + 'Read the report · EWTN/Britannica/etc.' with miracle-source-<id> testIDs (6 found). Community tab shows community-miracles-banner (1) and community-miracles-btn (1). Profile shows profile-admin-miracles-link (1) → /admin/miracles screen renders Generate drafts button (testID miracles-generate), 12 cards total (6 DRAFT + 6 PUBLISHED chips), four verdict chips (Reported/Investigating/Approved/Not Supernatural), Publish + Delete buttons. Italian (lang=it): header 'Diretta', subtitle 'Miracoli segnalati e il loro stato ecclesiastico', disclaimer 'Ogni voce è una rivendicazione segnalata…', badge 'Approvato dalla Chiesa', title & summary translated, link label 'Leggi il rapporto · EWTN'. Spanish (lang=es): header 'Transmisión en Vivo', subtitle 'Milagros reportados y su estado eclesiástico', badge 'Aprobado por la Iglesia', title & summary translated, 'Leer el informe'. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none.
critical_code_review_comments: miracles.py: admin endpoints rely on bool(getattr(user,'is_admin',False)) — consistent with rest of codebase. Generate endpoint dedupes by source_url only; if the model returns a duplicate title with a different URL it will create a near-duplicate draft. Optional: also dedupe by slug.

_localize() in miracles.py swallows translation exceptions silently (broad except Exception) — fine for graceful degradation, but consider logger.warning so cold-start translator failures are debuggable, mirroring server.py readings_i18n pattern.

/api/miracles/{claim_id} for non-admins enforces state=published (good). Admin GET still goes through the same route — currently it returns drafts too because is_admin bypasses the state filter; this is the intended behavior but worth a one-liner comment for the next reader.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 fast tests; slow generate skipped by marker, but verified live via UI showing 6 AI drafts with real URLs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all five required testIDs present and language switching translates header, subtitle, disclaimer, verdict badges, titles, summaries, and source link label

seed_data_creation: None new. The 6 seed claims are auto-inserted on first GET /api/miracles. The 6 AI DRAFT claims visible in /admin/miracles came from a prior generate run (per agent-to-agent context). A throwaway non-admin user+session is created and torn down inside test_non_admin_blocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Feed module is solid. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_miracles_iter60.py -v -m 'not slow'. To exercise the AI generate path manually: POST /api/miracles/admin/generate with body {"focus":"..."} and Bearer test_feat_aug25, allow ~30-90s. The seed slug for Fátima uses an accent — tests use a regex hint for that one. UI testIDs to look for next time: community-miracles-banner, community-miracles-btn, profile-admin-miracles-link, miracles-generate, miracle-source-<claim_id>.
rca_of_issue: No issues found — feature passes all checks. Only minor self-inflicted test bug (Fátima vs fatima) was fixed in-test by using a regex hint.
